datasets.name: ds_in
queryLines: select month, measure, amount from __CATALOG__.gold.monthly_flow_long where measure in ('Client receipts', 'Funding', 'Other credits')

datasets.name: ds_out
queryLines: select month, measure, amount from __CATALOG__.gold.monthly_flow_long where measure in ('Operating spend', 'Founder payout')

datasets.name: ds_monthly
queryLines: select month, client_receipts, funding_in, other_in, operating_spend, founder_payout, total_outflow, closing_balance, case when partial then 'partial' else 'full' end as month_type from __CATALOG__.gold.monthly_flow order by month

datasets.name: ds_cat
queryLines: select category, category_type, amount, txns from __CATALOG__.gold.category_totals order by amount desc

datasets.name: ds_cat_month
queryLines: select month, category, category_type, amount, txns from __CATALOG__.gold.spend_by_category_month order by month, amount desc

datasets.name: ds_recurring
queryLines: select payee, category, cadence, typical_amount, date_format(last_seen, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as last_seen, date_format(next_expected, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as next_expected, status, source from __CATALOG__.gold.upcoming_payments order by case status when 'upcoming' then 0 when 'lapsed' then 1 else 2 end, next_expected

datasets.name: ds_funding
queryLines: select month, category, amount, txns from __CATALOG__.gold.funding_received order by month, category

datasets.name: ds_founder
queryLines: select month, category, paid_to_founder, received_from_founder from __CATALOG__.gold.founder_monthly order by month

datasets.name: ds_review
queryLines: select category, direction, txns, amount from __CATALOG__.gold.review_summary

datasets.name: ds_status
queryLines: select file, statement_kind, date_format(period_from, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as period_from, date_format(period_to, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as period_to, txn_count, coalesce(duplicate_lines, 0) as duplicate_lines, cast(reconciled as string) as reconciled, date_format(ingested_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') as ingested_at from __CATALOG__.gold.statement_status order by statement_kind, file

datasets.name: ds_dups
queryLines: select file, statement_kind, duplicate_of, lines from __CATALOG__.gold.duplicate_lines order by file

datasets.name: ds_dr_flow
datasets.displayName: Cash flow by day and category
queryLines: select txn_date, category, category_type, money_in, money_out, net, txns from __CATALOG__.gold.cashflow_daily

datasets.name: ds_dr_long
datasets.displayName: Money in and out by day
queryLines: select txn_date, measure, amount from __CATALOG__.gold.cashflow_daily LATERAL VIEW STACK(2, 'Money in', money_in, 'Money out', money_out) t as measure, amount

datasets.name: ds_dr_tx
queryLines: select txn_date, date_format(txn_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as day, counterparty_clean, category, direction, amount from __CATALOG__.gold.fact_transactions order by txn_date desc, seq desc

datasets.name: ds_source
queryLines: select category_source, txns, amount from __CATALOG__.gold.category_source_mix order by txns desc

datasets.name: ds_queue
queryLines: select category, counterparty_clean, direction, txns, total, reason from __CATALOG__.gold.review_queue order by case when category = 'human-intervention-required' then 0 else 1 end, total desc

widget.name: txt_over
widget.textbox_spec:
# __COMPANY__ Finance
**Cash, outflow and runway** from the bank statements loaded so far. Every figure is a SQL view on `gold`; nothing here is generated by a model.

frame.title: Monthly cash flow (the data behind the three charts)

widget.name: txt_def
widget.textbox_spec: **Definitions.** Cash is the bank's closing balance on the latest statement. Monthly outflow is the mean of all debits, founder payouts included, over the last three full months; the current partial month is left out. Runway is cash divided by that outflow. Funding is money from founders and the investor; it is kept apart from client income.

widget.name: txt_range
widget.textbox_spec:
# Cash flow by date
Pick a date range. Every figure, chart and the payment list on this page follows it. Money in and out are the bank's own credits and debits; the balance is the bank's running balance after the last payment of each day.

frame.title: Money in and out by week
Money in and out by category (the data behind the chart)

widget.name: txt_spend
widget.textbox_spec:
# Where the money went
All debits, January to October 2026, by category. `unclassified` and `human-intervention-required` are not labelled yet.

frame.title: Spend by category (the data behind the chart)
Spend by month and category (the data behind the chart)

widget.name: txt_rec
widget.textbox_spec:
# Recurring and yearly payments
Found from the statements by a fixed gap and amount test, plus rent and the auditor fee which fall once a year (declared in config). *Lapsed* means it was expected and no payment came. *Ended* is an engagement you told us has stopped.

widget.name: txt_fund
widget.textbox_spec:
# Funding and founder
Money put in by founders and the investor, and payments to the founder (shown as operations, no further split).

frame.title: Funding received (the data behind the chart)

widget.name: txt_dq
widget.textbox_spec:
# Data quality
Every statement is checked against the bank's own totals before it is loaded. Payments that no rule, payee list or Jev label could place with confidence are listed here for a person.

frame.title: Duplicate line items (weekly and monthly overlap, counted once)
How payments were labelled (the data behind the chart)
